items.title_zh: 现状诊断图与资料缺口
proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
风险、版权与合规说明
completeness_limited_by: heritage, flood, utility, fire, and transport evidence
items.evidence_summary_zh: 现状诊断的可核对内容是缺口本身：三条 issue 分别记录总体范围位移、大钟寺位移与约束图层不全。 确切依据：章节 设计依据与资料清单、风险、版权与合规说明；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/site_boundary.geojson、geometry/constraints.geojson；指标 site_area_sqm、official_overall_design_area_sqm；来源 SITE-PACKAGE、SOURCE-REGISTRY、ISSUE-1774、ISSUE-846、ISSUE-1029；假设 A-BOUNDARY-001、A-CONTROLS-001；自检 SPATIAL_REVIEW。
items.evidence_summary_en: What can be checked in the diagnosis is the gap itself: three issues record overall-extent displacement, Dazhongsi displacement, and incomplete constraint layers. Exact references: sections 设计依据与资料清单, 风险、版权与合规说明; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/site_boundary.geojson, geometry/constraints.geojson; metrics site_area_sqm, official_overall_design_area_sqm; sources SITE-PACKAGE, SOURCE-REGISTRY, ISSUE-1774, ISSUE-846, ISSUE-1029; assumptions A-BOUNDARY-001, A-CONTROLS-001; self-checks SPATIAL_REVIEW.

proposal_sections: 三层范围工作框架
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
重点区域详细设计
items.evidence_summary_zh: 三层范围各有一个面积字段与一个几何图层对位，层级之间不混用同一数字。 确切依据：章节 三层范围工作框架、统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究、总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计、重点区域详细设计；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/site_boundary.geojson、geometry/key_areas.geojson；指标 official_overall_design_area_sqm、site_area_sqm、key_area_count；来源 OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT、BOUNDARY-SOURCE、KEY-AREA-SOURCE；假设 A-BOUNDARY-001；自检 SPATIAL_REVIEW。
items.evidence_summary_en: Each of the three scopes is matched to one area field and one geometry layer; no single number is reused across levels. Exact references: sections 三层范围工作框架, 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究, 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计, 重点区域详细设计; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/site_boundary.geojson, geometry/key_areas.geojson; metrics official_overall_design_area_sqm, site_area_sqm, key_area_count; sources OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT, BOUNDARY-SOURCE, KEY-AREA-SOURCE; assumptions A-BOUNDARY-001; self-checks SPATIAL_REVIEW.

proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
items.evidence_summary_zh: 空间结构中的持续与分歧廊道计数来自探针，属于对候选集合的选择稳定性描述，不是对城市运行的测量。 确切依据：章节 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计、蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌；图纸 drawings/a0-boards.pdf；图层 geometry/land_use.geojson、geometry/roads.geojson、geometry/green_space.geojson；指标 land_use_partition_coverage_ratio、persistent_corridor_count、disagreement_corridor_count；来源 BOUNDARY-SOURCE、ISSUE-1774、PHYSARUM-TOKYO-2010；假设 A-NETWORK-001、A-WEIGHTS-001；自检 DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION。
items.evidence_summary_en: The persistent and disagreement corridor counts come from the probe and describe selection stability over a candidate set; they are not a measurement of how the city runs. Exact references: sections 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计, 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌; drawings drawings/a0-boards.pdf; layers geometry/land_use.geojson, geometry/roads.geojson, geometry/green_space.geojson; metrics land_use_partition_coverage_ratio, persistent_corridor_count, disagreement_corridor_count; sources BOUNDARY-SOURCE, ISSUE-1774, PHYSARUM-TOKYO-2010; assumptions A-NETWORK-001, A-WEIGHTS-001; self-checks DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION.

proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
completeness_limited_by: approved land-use plan and parcel boundaries
items.evidence_summary_zh: 用地布局为概念分区，覆盖率字段说明其对临时多边形的覆盖程度，不等于批复用地。 确切依据：章节 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计、用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案；图纸 drawings/a0-boards.pdf；图层 geometry/land_use.geojson；指标 land_use_partition_coverage_ratio、green_ratio、public_space_ratio；来源 BOUNDARY-SOURCE、ISSUE-1774、SITE-PACKAGE；假设 A-CONTROLS-001；自检 SPATIAL_REVIEW。
items.evidence_summary_en: The layout is a conceptual partition; the coverage field states how much of the provisional polygon it covers and is not an approved land-use plan. Exact references: sections 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计, 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案; drawings drawings/a0-boards.pdf; layers geometry/land_use.geojson; metrics land_use_partition_coverage_ratio, green_ratio, public_space_ratio; sources BOUNDARY-SOURCE, ISSUE-1774, SITE-PACKAGE; assumptions A-CONTROLS-001; self-checks SPATIAL_REVIEW.

items.title_zh: 开发强度或待确认控规条件
proposal_sections: 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
风险、版权与合规说明
completeness_limited_by: approved FAR, height, density, and setback controls
items.evidence_summary_zh: 容积率与限高两个字段保持未知状态，本条据此登记为待确认控规条件，而非已确定强度。 确切依据：章节 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案、风险、版权与合规说明；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/constraints.geojson、geometry/buildings.geojson；指标 floor_area_ratio、approved_height_limit_m、building_footprint_area_sqm；来源 ISSUE-1774、GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL、DB11-T-2209-2023-OFFICIAL；假设 A-CONTROLS-001、A-BUILDING-001；自检 PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE。
items.evidence_summary_en: The floor-area-ratio and height-limit fields stay unknown, so this item is registered as a control condition awaiting confirmation rather than a settled intensity. Exact references: sections 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案, 风险、版权与合规说明; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/constraints.geojson, geometry/buildings.geojson; metrics floor_area_ratio, approved_height_limit_m, building_footprint_area_sqm; sources ISSUE-1774, GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL, DB11-T-2209-2023-OFFICIAL; assumptions A-CONTROLS-001, A-BUILDING-001; self-checks PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE.

items.title_zh: 建筑高度、体量与风貌控制
proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
completeness_limited_by: survey, heritage review, approved height, fire, and structural evidence
items.evidence_summary_zh: 体量控制只到地面层与遮蔽层：边界告示、共享工作间、遮盖等候三处构件说明尺度感，不作立面或天际线主张。 确切依据：章节 重点区域详细设计、用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案、蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌；图纸 drawings/a0-boards.pdf；图层 geometry/buildings.geojson、geometry/key_areas.geojson；指标 approved_height_limit_m、building_footprint_area_sqm；来源 SHEARING-LAYERS-BRAND-1994、OPEN-BUILDING-HABRAKEN-2021、DB11-T-2209-2023-OFFICIAL；假设 A-BUILDING-001；自检 SPATIAL_REVIEW；图版 ZZY-03、AIO-03、DZS-03。
items.evidence_summary_en: Massing is controlled only at ground and shelter level: the boundary notice, the shared workroom, and the sheltered waiting module carry the sense of scale without any facade or skyline claim. Exact references: sections 重点区域详细设计, 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案, 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌; drawings drawings/a0-boards.pdf; layers geometry/buildings.geojson, geometry/key_areas.geojson; metrics approved_height_limit_m, building_footprint_area_sqm; sources SHEARING-LAYERS-BRAND-1994, OPEN-BUILDING-HABRAKEN-2021, DB11-T-2209-2023-OFFICIAL; assumptions A-BUILDING-001; self-checks SPATIAL_REVIEW; plates ZZY-03, AIO-03, DZS-03.

proposal_sections: 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
completeness_limited_by: ownership, building survey, structural, fire, heritage, and social-impact evidence
items.evidence_summary_zh: 本包不提出任何拆除；三个片区各一个一期可逆范围，全部登记为可撤回、未获授权、未落实资金。 确切依据：章节 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案、更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/buildings.geojson、geometry/phasing.geojson；指标 building_footprint_area_sqm、phase1_reversible_area_sqm；来源 OPEN-BUILDING-HABRAKEN-2021、REAL-OPTIONS-NEUFVILLE-2003、BLUEVIEW-RENEWAL-CASE-2026；假设 A-BUILDING-001、A-PILOT-001；自检 PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE；图版 ZZY-03、AIO-03、DZS-03；范围 ENV-ZY-01、ENV-AO-01、ENV-DZ-01。
items.evidence_summary_en: No demolition is proposed; each area carries one Phase 1 reversible envelope, all registered as withdrawable, not authorized, and unfunded. Exact references: sections 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案, 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/buildings.geojson, geometry/phasing.geojson; metrics building_footprint_area_sqm, phase1_reversible_area_sqm; sources OPEN-BUILDING-HABRAKEN-2021, REAL-OPTIONS-NEUFVILLE-2003, BLUEVIEW-RENEWAL-CASE-2026; assumptions A-BUILDING-001, A-PILOT-001; self-checks PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE; plates ZZY-03, AIO-03, DZS-03; envelopes ENV-ZY-01, ENV-AO-01, ENV-DZ-01.

items.title_zh: 道路、轨道、慢行与停车组织
proposal_sections: 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
completeness_limited_by: observed OD demand, official road and rail redlines, parking survey, and engineering review
items.evidence_summary_zh: 慢行部分是九条区内无障碍连续路径；轨道与停车缺少观测数据，登记为未完成而非以代理值填补。 确切依据：章节 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施、总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计；图纸 drawings/a0-boards.pdf；图层 geometry/roads.geojson、geometry/constraints.geojson；指标 network_detour_factor、single_edge_loss_retention、disagreement_share；来源 ISSUE-1774、GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL、PHYSARUM-TOKYO-2010；假设 A-NETWORK-001；自检 DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION；图版 ZZY-04、AIO-04、DZS-04；路径 Z-R01、Z-R04、O-R01、O-R02、O-R03、O-R04等 9 项。
items.evidence_summary_en: The slow-mobility part is nine area-internal step-free chains; rail and parking lack observed data and are registered as incomplete rather than filled with a proxy. Exact references: sections 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施, 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计; drawings drawings/a0-boards.pdf; layers geometry/roads.geojson, geometry/constraints.geojson; metrics network_detour_factor, single_edge_loss_retention, disagreement_share; sources ISSUE-1774, GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL, PHYSARUM-TOKYO-2010; assumptions A-NETWORK-001; self-checks DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION; plates ZZY-04, AIO-04, DZS-04; routes Z-R01, Z-R04, O-R01, O-R02, O-R03, O-R04 and 3 more of 9.

items.title_zh: 市政与新型基础设施策略
proposal_sections: 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
风险、版权与合规说明
completeness_limited_by: utility survey, capacity, fire access, power, water, drainage, and telecom evidence
items.evidence_summary_zh: 新型基础设施只表达为可维护性：备件与维修位、维修模块、维护员站位，配套零件库行动。管网容量证据不足，不作主张。 确切依据：章节 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施、AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景、风险、版权与合规说明；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/constraints.geojson、geometry/buildings.geojson；指标 building_footprint_area_sqm；来源 ISSUE-1774、GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL、SITE-PACKAGE；假设 A-CONTROLS-001；自检 PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE；构件 Z-C04、D-C02、D-C05；行动 P10。
items.evidence_summary_en: New infrastructure is expressed only as maintainability — the parts and repair bay, the repair module, the maintainer station, with the parts-library action. Utility capacity evidence is missing and no claim is made. Exact references: sections 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施, AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景, 风险、版权与合规说明; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/constraints.geojson, geometry/buildings.geojson; metrics building_footprint_area_sqm; sources ISSUE-1774, GB-55019-2021-OFFICIAL, SITE-PACKAGE; assumptions A-CONTROLS-001; self-checks PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE; components Z-C04, D-C02, D-C05; actions P10.

proposal_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
completeness_limited_by: authoritative flood, habitat, tree, soil, and drainage evidence
items.evidence_summary_zh: 蓝绿与公共空间的深度落在冬季可用性上：三张冬季图版说明遮盖、照明与除雪配对，不以四季均好的笼统说法代替。 确切依据：章节 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌、交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施；图纸 drawings/a0-boards.pdf；图层 geometry/green_space.geojson、geometry/public_space.geojson、geometry/roads.geojson；指标 green_space_area_sqm、public_space_area_sqm、green_ratio、public_space_ratio；来源 BLUEVIEW-DISPOSITION-2025、CASE-KALASATAMA、ISSUE-1774；假设 A-CLIMATE-001、A-EQUITY-001；自检 SPATIAL_REVIEW；图版 ZZY-04、AIO-04、DZS-04；行动 P02、P08。
items.evidence_summary_en: Depth in the blue-green and public-space item lands on winter usability: three winter plates carry shelter, lighting, and clearing pairing instead of a general all-season claim. Exact references: sections 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌, 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施; drawings drawings/a0-boards.pdf; layers geometry/green_space.geojson, geometry/public_space.geojson, geometry/roads.geojson; metrics green_space_area_sqm, public_space_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio; sources BLUEVIEW-DISPOSITION-2025, CASE-KALASATAMA, ISSUE-1774; assumptions A-CLIMATE-001, A-EQUITY-001; self-checks SPATIAL_REVIEW; plates ZZY-04, AIO-04, DZS-04; actions P02, P08.

items.title_zh: 三大重点片区详细设计
proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
重点区构件与路径登记表
completeness_limited_by: official key-area polygons, parcel ownership, station interfaces, and surveyed conditions
items.evidence_summary_zh: 三个片区各 5 张图版（中英各出一版，共 30 个成品）、5 个构件、1 个一期可逆范围，内容互不重复；合计 9 条无障碍连续路径，按各片区实有的步行路径登记，不为凑数补足。大钟寺全程非地理参照、非站点。 确切依据：章节 重点区域详细设计、重点区构件与路径登记表；图纸 drawings/a0-boards.pdf、drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/key_areas.geojson、geometry/buildings.geojson、geometry/public_space.geojson；指标 key_area_count、phase1_reversible_area_sqm；来源 KEY-AREA-SOURCE、ISSUE-1029、OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT；假设 A-BOUNDARY-001、A-EQUITY-001；自检 SPATIAL_REVIEW、PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE；图版 ZZY-01、ZZY-02、ZZY-03、ZZY-04、ZZY-05、AIO-01等 15 项；构件 Z-C01、Z-C02、Z-C03、Z-C04、Z-C05、O-C01等 15 项；路径 Z-R01、Z-R04、O-R01、O-R02、O-R03、O-R04等 9 项；范围 ENV-ZY-01、ENV-AO-01、ENV-DZ-01。
items.evidence_summary_en: Each area carries 5 plates — issued as a Chinese and an English raster, 30 files in all — with 5 components and 1 Phase 1 reversible envelope, and no content repeated between them. Nine step-free chains are registered in total, as many as each area actually has rather than a fixed quota. Dazhongsi stays non-georeferenced and non-station throughout. Exact references: sections 重点区域详细设计, 重点区构件与路径登记表; drawings drawings/a0-boards.pdf, drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/key_areas.geojson, geometry/buildings.geojson, geometry/public_space.geojson; metrics key_area_count, phase1_reversible_area_sqm; sources KEY-AREA-SOURCE, ISSUE-1029, OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT; assumptions A-BOUNDARY-001, A-EQUITY-001; self-checks SPATIAL_REVIEW, PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE; plates ZZY-01, ZZY-02, ZZY-03, ZZY-04, ZZY-05, AIO-01 and 9 more of 15; components Z-C01, Z-C02, Z-C03, Z-C04, Z-C05, O-C01 and 9 more of 15; routes Z-R01, Z-R04, O-R01, O-R02, O-R03, O-R04 and 3 more of 9; envelopes ENV-ZY-01, ENV-AO-01, ENV-DZ-01.

proposal_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
更新行动治理登记表
completeness_limited_by: project sponsors, land authority, funding, procurement, and approvals
items.evidence_summary_zh: 十二项行动逐项登记操作角色、维护方、受益者、最受影响群体、指标、拟议目标、停止触发与停止权、回退、实物复原、剩余责任、非数字备用方式、资金状态与未决 D 类关口；均未获授权、未落实资金，且不指定任何具名主体。 确切依据：章节 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划、更新行动治理登记表；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/phasing.geojson、geometry/buildings.geojson；指标 phase1_reversible_area_sqm；来源 BLUEVIEW-RENEWAL-CASE-2026、OSTROM-COMMONS-1990、BEIJING-RESPONSIBILITY-PLANNER-2024；假设 A-PILOT-001；自检 PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE；行动 P00、P01、P02、P03、P04、P05等 12 项。
items.evidence_summary_en: All twelve actions register an operator role, maintainer, beneficiary, worst-affected group, metric, proposed target, stop trigger and stop authority, rollback, physical restoration, residual liability, non-digital fallback, funding state, and outstanding Class D gates; all are unauthorized and unfunded, and none names a party. Exact references: sections 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划, 更新行动治理登记表; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/phasing.geojson, geometry/buildings.geojson; metrics phase1_reversible_area_sqm; sources BLUEVIEW-RENEWAL-CASE-2026, OSTROM-COMMONS-1990, BEIJING-RESPONSIBILITY-PLANNER-2024; assumptions A-PILOT-001; self-checks PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE; actions P00, P01, P02, P03, P04, P05 and 6 more of 12.

proposal_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
风险、版权与合规说明
completeness_limited_by: confirmed owners, budgets, approvals, maintenance contracts, and adoption decisions
items.evidence_summary_zh: 分期以「先证据、后试点、再重跑」三步成立，每步都可停止且可复原；三条参考文献只提供分段承诺的语境，不构成财务评估。 确切依据：章节 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划、风险、版权与合规说明；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/phasing.geojson；指标 phase1_reversible_area_sqm；来源 REAL-OPTIONS-NEUFVILLE-2003、HOLLING-ADAPTIVE-CYCLE-2001、OSTROM-POLYCENTRIC-2010；假设 A-PILOT-001；自检 PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE；范围 ENV-ZY-01、ENV-AO-01、ENV-DZ-01；行动 P00、P01、P11。
items.evidence_summary_en: Phasing holds as three steps — evidence first, then pilot, then rerun — each stoppable and restorable; the three references supply staged-commitment context only and constitute no financial appraisal. Exact references: sections 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划, 风险、版权与合规说明; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/phasing.geojson; metrics phase1_reversible_area_sqm; sources REAL-OPTIONS-NEUFVILLE-2003, HOLLING-ADAPTIVE-CYCLE-2001, OSTROM-POLYCENTRIC-2010; assumptions A-PILOT-001; self-checks PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE; envelopes ENV-ZY-01, ENV-AO-01, ENV-DZ-01; actions P00, P01, P11.

proposal_sections: 指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
风险、版权与合规说明
items.evidence_summary_zh: 七个字段各自给出定义、来源图层与计算脚本；ISSUE-1781 要求自定义指标有精确定义，ISSUE-2170 要求方法主要结果在正文可见。 确切依据：章节 指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵、风险、版权与合规说明；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/site_boundary.geojson、geometry/land_use.geojson、geometry/roads.geojson、geometry/green_space.geojson、geometry/public_space.geojson、geometry/buildings.geojson；指标 site_area_sqm、land_use_partition_coverage_ratio、green_ratio、public_space_ratio、building_footprint_area_sqm、network_detour_factor、single_edge_loss_retention；来源 ISSUE-1781、ISSUE-2170、SITE-PACKAGE、BOUNDARY-SOURCE；假设 A-BOUNDARY-001、A-WEIGHTS-001；自检 DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION。
items.evidence_summary_en: Each of the seven fields carries its definition, source layer, and computing script; ISSUE-1781 requires precise definitions for custom metrics and ISSUE-2170 requires the principal results to be visible in the proposal body. Exact references: sections 指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵, 风险、版权与合规说明; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/site_boundary.geojson, geometry/land_use.geojson, geometry/roads.geojson, geometry/green_space.geojson, geometry/public_space.geojson, geometry/buildings.geojson; metrics site_area_sqm, land_use_partition_coverage_ratio, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, building_footprint_area_sqm, network_detour_factor, single_edge_loss_retention; sources ISSUE-1781, ISSUE-2170, SITE-PACKAGE, BOUNDARY-SOURCE; assumptions A-BOUNDARY-001, A-WEIGHTS-001; self-checks DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION.

proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
风险、版权与合规说明
items.evidence_summary_zh: 两个未知指标字段是本条最直接的证据：它们说明缺资料被保留为未知，而不是被代理值替换。季节性资格记录保持未选用状态。 确切依据：章节 设计依据与资料清单、风险、版权与合规说明；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/constraints.geojson、geometry/site_boundary.geojson；指标 floor_area_ratio、approved_height_limit_m；来源 ISSUE-1774、ISSUE-846、ISSUE-1029、SOURCE-REGISTRY、BEIJING-METEOROLOGICAL-SEASONAL-QUALIFICATION；假设 A-CONTROLS-001、A-CLIMATE-001、A-BOUNDARY-001；自检 PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE。
items.evidence_summary_en: The two unknown metric fields are this item's most direct evidence: they show missing data kept as unknown rather than replaced by a proxy. The seasonal qualification record stays not selected. Exact references: sections 设计依据与资料清单, 风险、版权与合规说明; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/constraints.geojson, geometry/site_boundary.geojson; metrics floor_area_ratio, approved_height_limit_m; sources ISSUE-1774, ISSUE-846, ISSUE-1029, SOURCE-REGISTRY, BEIJING-METEOROLOGICAL-SEASONAL-QUALIFICATION; assumptions A-CONTROLS-001, A-CLIMATE-001, A-BOUNDARY-001; self-checks PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE.
